records.name: Upopoy: National Ainu Museum and Park
records.what: The national center for learning about and reviving Ainu history and culture, with the National Ainu Museum, an open-air park and a memorial site, on the shore of Lake Poroto.
records.who: Ainu people and anyone who wants to learn about Ainu culture.
records.start: Check opening hours and tickets on the official website.
